name: Barnaby the Baker
conversations: Fresh bread! Well. Fresh-ish. With no breeze the oven smoke just sits there and the whole village smells like toast.
I've had complaints. Mostly from me.
My windmill bread was famous. The flour came from the big mill, ground by the wind.
Now I grind it by hand. My arms are enormous. Have a look. ... No, really, have a look.
People used to come for honey buns on Breath Day. Pastries shaped like little clouds.
Nobody's asked for one in years. I still bake a batch. Just in case.
The bread's gone flat lately. Not the dough, the feeling. Everything's a bit flat.
Have a croissant. It won't fix anything, but it's buttery.
